invariants.description: q_lung_V is exactly amp(t) sin(2π t/T(t) + φ) + q_baseline, with the piecewise amplitude and period of the perturbation windows (relative 1e-9)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(q_lung_V - (np.where((t < t_start_q_lung_amp) | (t > t_end_q_lung_amp), q_lung_max, q_lung_max*q_lung_max_multiplier)*np.sin(2*np.pi/np.where((t < t_start_T_lung) | (t > t_end_T_lung), T_lung_0, T_lung_0*T_lung_multiplier)*t + phi_lung) + q_lung_baseline))) <= 1e-9*np.max(np.abs(q_lung_V))

invariants.description: lung volume stays within baseline ± the largest amplitude, and positive

bc_sweep.rationale: Breathing periods 2.5-6 s (10-24 breaths/min), half tidal volumes 0.1-0.5 L, mid-tidal baselines 1.8-3.5 L (about FRC), rate and depth multipliers from halving to doubling/tripling (exercise-like), perturbation windows anywhere in the 60 s run.

baseline.reason: prescribed input (a sinusoidal lung volume); its values are sourced physiological constants. Validation belongs to the stretch-receptor model it drives.

calibrate.note: not_applicable: prescribed input (a sinusoidal lung volume); its values are sourced physiological constants. Validation belongs to the stretch-receptor model it drives.
